title: When the Room Changes
headline: Why You Act Differently Around Certain People
tagline: Some truths become expensive only when certain people walk into the room.
seo_title: Why You Act Differently Around Certain People: Galatians 2 | TheWrkShop
seo_description: Peter knew the truth and still changed when the room changed. A devotional for men on Galatians 2:11-13, peer pressure and fear of man.
verse_text: For before certain men came from James, he used to eat with the Gentiles. But when they arrived, he began to draw back and separate himself from the Gentiles because he was afraid….

scriptures.text: For before certain men came from James, he used to eat with the Gentiles. But when they arrived, he began to draw back and separate himself from the Gentiles because he was afraid….
Fear of man will prove to be a snare, but whoever trusts in the LORD is kept safe.

items: That’s what makes Galatians 2 so powerful.
Peter already knew God had welcomed Gentiles.
He had seen the Spirit fall on Cornelius’ household.
In Antioch, he had been eating with Gentile believers.
And suddenly Peter started behaving differently.

blocks.text: Paul tells us what activated inside him:

items: Fear of people began negotiating with what Peter already knew was true.

blocks.text: “If I know what I believe, the people around me can’t change me.”

items: Not because someone gave him a better argument.
Social pressure doesn’t always change what you believe. Sometimes it changes what you’re willing to live.
What you normalize can become someone else’s permission.
Every room has an unwritten curriculum.
What kind of man does this room teach me to become?
Jesus is Lord of this room too.
